summary: Eldorado Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing a press release reminding shareholders of its June 23, 2026 annual meeting and providing an update on its Board leadership transition. The Board is advancing a succession process to identify a successor to Chair Steven Reid, with the appointment expected by September 30, 2026. The meeting is the first since Eldorado's acquisition of Foran Mining in April 2026. Proxy voting deadlines are set for June 19, 2026. No financial terms or deal mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine governance filing regarding management succession, not a special situation transaction.
